messages:
taylor: Opening follow-up for MeridianLabs outage (INC-2026-0621). Goal: pin owners for remediation of peering blackhole + on-prem firewall interaction.
infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-0621 logged. Severity: P2. https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0621
juan: summary: their legacy F5 device closed half-open connections, causing BGP resets. our peering reconciler then issued aggressive withdrawals because it detected stale tags for routes. Outcome: tenant traffic blackholed for ~22m.
priya: runtime detail: reconciler's delete path is synchronous and retried immediately; when backlog climbs it amplifies churn. need to stop hard deletes during noisy windows.
sre-lead: propose immediate triage + longer-term change. Immediate: disable auto-delete for MeridianLabs peering for 48h while we test. Long-term: add a deferred-delete state machine.
taylor: Action items: 1) Juan -> coordinate customer test window and temporary firewall relax (due 2026-06-05). 2) Priya -> implement deferred-delete (PENDING -> GRACE -> DELETE) with default grace 900s, emit metric peering.deferred_deletes (due 2026-06-19). 3) Taylor -> create peering-health dashboard and weekly digest for 6w (due 2026-06-07).
juan: I'll reach out to MeridianOps and propose a 2h window. will capture tcpdump + BGP debug output. acceptance: no withdrawn prefixes >2m during window.
priya: plan for deferred-delete: on tag mismatch mark route PENDING with timestamp; only enqueue DELETE if state not cleared after grace and reconciliation backlog < threshold. I'll add unit tests + staging chaos test. PR by 2026-06-10.
sre-lead: add test requirements: unit tests for state transitions, integration test that simulates SYN-flood + BGP flap, and a Dedicated canary that runs synthetic flows every 5m.
deploy-bot: CI started for branches/priya/deferred-delete. build #1423 in progress.
taylor: We'll also create a small monitoring alert: if peering.deferred_deletes > 50 in 10m for a tenant, page SRE on-call. Who owns alert?
juan: I can own the alert on-call rule and dashboard widgets. estimate 2d.
priya: RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/deferred-delete-peering (draft). feedback appreciated.
taylor: JIRA please: create INC-2026-0621-1 (Meridian test window) INC-2026-0621-2 (Deferred delete feature) INC-2026-0621-3 (Dashboard + alerts). Link PRs and RFC.
infra-bot: JIRA tasks created and linked to incident.
sre-lead: Ownership summary: Juan (customer test + alerts) | Priya (deferred-delete + tests) | Taylor (dashboard + incident owner). Set follow-up sync in 1 week.
taylor: scheduling 30m sync next Tue 11am PT. please update JIRA before the meeting. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
